title: Ottawa: skating to work
old_caption: Capricorn skates to work on schedule every day, right past the same cute face. Slowing down is allowed, Capricorn. Which sign would pencil in a crush?

title: Calgary: the chinook crush
old_caption: Aquarius was not ready for a warm wind in the middle of winter, or for feelings. Some things thaw fast. Which sign gets the weirdest when they like someone?

title: Winnipeg: tears that sparkle
old_caption: It's so cold here that Pisces' tears come out as glitter, and honestly it's a look. A spare mitten helps too. Which sign cries at the first snowfall?

title: Quebec City: two walls, one gate
old_caption: Cancer and Capricorn found a whole city built like them: walls everywhere. Then the maple taffy came out and one gate opened. Which two signs need this trip?

title: Salt Lake City: across the widest street
old_caption: Gemini and Sagittarius are opposite signs, and here they're also on opposite sides of a very wide street. Good news: there's a crosswalk. Who are you yelling across the street to?

title: Reykjavik: reading the sky
old_caption: Aquarius tried to decode the northern lights for proof of a crush. The lights said sock. A simple question said a lot more. Who in your group chat reads the signs instead of asking?

title: Quebec City: maple on snow
old_caption: Heart one ran. Heart two was a potato. Heart three just needed a minute. Taurus waiting near warm syrup is the most romantic thing on this page. What would you wait for?

title: Edinburgh: Old Town, New Town
old_caption: Old Town Gemini wants candlelight, New Town Gemini wants a plan, and Middle Gemini wants a snack. Turns out the right one likes the whole committee. Which one of you shows up first?

title: Copenhagen: the coziest flat
old_caption: Cancer built the coziest flat in the city: candles, blanket, cocoa. Missing piece: walking out the door. Tag the friend whose place is perfect and who never leaves it.

title: Vienna: the grand entrance
old_caption: Entrance one: flawless. Entrance two: sparkles. Entrance three: the stairs won. The one worth keeping clapped for all three. Be honest, how many entrances have you rehearsed?
